parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const batches=$('Screen and Prepare Sources').all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const byId=new Map(rows.filter(x=>x.batch_id).map(x=>[String(x.batch_id),x])); const MAX_PRIMARY_ATTEMPTS=2,MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS=2; const retryable=[],exhausted=[]; for(const batch of batches){const row=byId.get(String(batch.batchId));if(!row)throw new Error('Missing batch ledger row: '+batch.batchId);if(row.status==='completed')continue;const primaryAttempts=Number(row.primary_attempts||0),recoveryAttempts=Number(row.recovery_attempts||0);if(primaryAttempts>=MAX_PRIMARY_ATTEMPTS||recoveryAttempts>=MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS){exhausted.push({batchId:batch.batchId,status:row.status,primaryAttempts,recoveryAttempts,errorMessage:row.error_message||null});continue;}retryable.push({json:{...batch,primaryAttempts,recoveryAttempts,ledgerRowId:row.id,attemptHistory:Array.isArray(row.attempt_history)?row.attempt_history:[]}});} if(retryable.length)return retryable;if(exhausted.length)return [{json:{allCompleted:true,retryExhausted:true,exhaustedBatches:exhausted}}];return [{json:{allCompleted:true}}];

const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json); if(rows.length!==1||rows[0].batchId!=='batch-0001')throw new Error('Retry cap selection incorrect: '+JSON.stringify(rows)); return [{json:{testPassed:true,retryableBatchIds:rows.map(x=>x.batchId),maxPrimaryAttempts:2,maxRecoveryAttempts:2}}];
